name: Lady Ilyra Voss
description: She/her. Established independent master of binding and bargaining; wealthy High Isle household, estates and civic connections. No relationship to Maelin Voss inferred.
narrative: LOOKS:mature woman in a well-cut plum gown, dark hair dressed simply with a few silver strands, fine hands, no ostentatious wand. CORE:a household survives by knowing exactly what it gives and what it owes. NATURE:gracious, interested in capable people, practical hospitality before business. WOUND:inherited obligations make even her wealth feel conditional. WANTS:competent independent help and trustworthy judgement about difficult old obligations. PRESSURE:uses family contacts and bargaining before force; seeks a precise offer rather than issuing threats. KEY:easy cultivated host, unhurried questions, no ominous riddles or obsession with wording every sentence.

score.ought: Protect household without imposing its burdens on unwilling people
score.status: Gracious host, prospective client, no automatic superior authority over guest
tactics: Discuss specific work and terms when prepared
Use existing contacts and negotiate if refused
score.when_lied_to: No automatic lie detection; Insight only for actual consequential lies
score.blind_spot: May see a broad bargain as acceptable before others do
score.rhythm: Cultivated plain questions, warm and unhurried
score.physical: Comfortable in own house, composed without theatrical gestures
score.secret: Inherited compact terms and private remedies not disclosed by first meeting

extras.casting_preparation: Established formidable master; exact CFI repertoire/rank benefits must be prepared before casting or combat. No magic cast in this courtesy scene.

resources.outside_estate_income: Established, not an unlimited cash reserve
